Chummer public route guide

Overview
- Chummer is the public front door for the Shadowrun desktop character tools.
- The main public routes are Downloads, Help, Status, and Contact.
- Signed-in account pages exist for recovery and support history, but the public pages remain readable without an account.

Primary routes
- / : landing and product entry
- /what-is-chummer : product story
- /downloads : Stable and Nightly installers
- /downloads/concierge : guided install help
- /docs : help documents
- /docs/chummer6-quickstart : quickstart guide
- /docs/chummer6-quickstart/download.pdf : quickstart PDF
- /join/primer : campaign invite primer
- /status : current release
- /progress : progress notes
- /testimonials/concierge : testimonial follow-up

Direction and feedback routes
- /horizons : maintenance page
- /roadmap : planned work
- /feedback : public feedback
- /changelog : shipped closeout and release-backed updates
- /alice : character helper entry
- /table-pulse : Table Pulse live and aftermath public split
- /quicksilver : Quicksilver expert-speed command deck and jump-target lane
- /local-co-processor : Local Co-Processor hosted-first optional-acceleration lane
- /participate : broader participation entry
- /karma-forge : discovery intake
- /participate/karma-forge : discovery intake for table pain and house-rule demand

Help and account routes
- /help : help entry
- /faq : public FAQ
- /contact : private support and follow-up
- /home : signed-in return surface
- /account : signed-in account, account return, and follow settings

Reading rules
- Treat /roadmap and /horizons as planned or maintenance pages.
- Use /downloads, /status, and /changelog when the question is what is available now.
- Use /feedback for public requests and safe public bugs.
- Use /contact or /help when the issue is private, recovery-bound, or account-specific.

Boundary notes
- Downloads is the public install page.
- Help and Contact are the public support paths.
